defs.def: to succeed in attracting and keeping sb's attention and interest 吸引住（注意力、兴趣）

ex.s: He co-founded the Frank Lloyd Wright Building Conservancy, an organization engaged in the preservation of all of Wright’s remaining buildings.
ex.t: 他联合创立了弗兰克·劳埃德·赖特建筑保护协会，该组织致力于保护赖特现存的所有建筑。

ex.s: Even those who didn’t share that interest with me seemed more engaged once I showed a different side of myself.
ex.t: 即使是那些与我没有共同兴趣的学生，在我展现了不同的自我之后，似乎也更投入了。

ex.s: Your eyes were engaged, but your mind was not.
ex.t: 你的眼睛在看，但你的心不在焉。

ex.s: Even the most engaged and committed audience will eventually get bored.
ex.t: 骑行是最经济、最可持续、最有趣的探索这座城市的方式，这里有美丽的运河、公园、广场和无数的灯光。

ex.s: Explorers Camp organizes engaging arts, history and science-related activities in every! class, and focuses on a range of topics that emphasize active learning, exploration and, most of all, fun!
ex.t: 探索者营在每节课中组织引人入胜的艺术、历史和科学相关活动，并专注于强调主动学习、探索，最重要的是乐趣的一系列主题！

ex.s: Just a few days after the signs went up, he found people sitting there and engaging in active and   28   conversations.
ex.t: 他请求警察部门允许他在当地两个公园里设置几张"聊天长椅"。然后他在每张长椅上挂了一个彩色标牌，上面写着："乐意聊天"。

ex.s: 3．（1分）A study shows the students who are engaged in after﹣school activities are happier than________who are not．（  ）
ex.t: 3．（1分）一项研究表明，参加课外活动的学生比________不参加的学生更快乐。（  ）

ex.s: The scene you set at the beginning of your writing — whether it is fiction or non-fiction — will engage your readers and help set the right atmosphere for the remainder of your writing.
ex.t: 你在一篇文章开头设置的场景——无论是虚构还是非虚构——都会吸引你的读者，并为你余下的写作营造恰当的氛围。

ex.s: Now we are engaged in a great civil war, testing whether that nation, or any nation, so conceived, and so dedicated, can long endure.
ex.t: 现在我们正投身于一场伟大的内战，考验这个国家，或任何这样孕育并奉行这一信念的国家，是否能长久存在。

defs.def: to employ sb to do a particular job 雇用；聘用
to become involved with and try to understand sth/sb 与 … 建立密切关系；尽力理解

ex.s: This adaptability ensures that complex historical concepts become accessible and engaging for young minds.
ex.t: 这种适应性确保复杂的历史概念能够被年轻的心灵所理解和喜爱。

ex.s: Your audience will naturally be more interested and engaged when you tailor your communications to their interests. ___37___ This will engage their desire to understand and interact with the information.
ex.t: 当您根据受众的兴趣量身定制沟通内容时，他们自然会更有兴趣、更投入。___37___（这会）激发他们理解和互动信息的欲望。

ex.s: Smart recommendation engines analyze data such as exhibit popularity and visitors’ past behavior to suggest specific exhibits and events, making each visit unique and surprising. _____37_____ These digital assistants engage visitors in dynamic conversations and offer context-sensitive insights that deepen understanding and satisfy curiosity.
ex.t: 智能推荐引擎会分析展品受欢迎程度和参观者过往行为等数据，推荐特定的展品和活动，让每次参观都独一无二、充满惊喜。_____37_____ 这些数字助手与参观者进行动态对话，并提供契合情境的解说，加深理解、满足好奇心。

defs.def: to begin fighting with sb 与（某人）交战；与（某人）开战
when a part of a machine engages, or when you engage it, it fits together with another part of the machine and the machine begins to work （使）衔接，啮合

ex.s: When I let them see an aspect of my life outside of school, some students who were also interested in cars connected with me more and became more engaged in my courses.
ex.t: 当我让他们看到我校外生活的一面时，一些同样喜欢汽车的学生与我更亲近了，也更投入我的课程。

ex.s: Students are encouraged to 3 engage in community related projects to support local neighbourhoods with information campaigns.
ex.t: 鼓励学生 3 参与社区相关项目，通过宣传活动支持当地社区。

ex.s: Understanding history is vital to understanding ourselves as a people and as a nation． History is much more than the study of dusty old objects and events long past． It is an essential part of who we are today and who we will become． Thornton Middle School History Fair Competition makes understanding history exciting， engaging， and fun!
ex.t: 16.（30分）一天晚上，我准备好在杂货店付款时，恐惧突然攫住了我。我的钱包不见了。我只能把它落在G9公交车上了，那辆车此刻正驶入黑暗中的某个车站。（1）

ex.s: Engage your mind.
ex.t: 让你的大脑参与进来。

ex.s: When ____17____ (travel), we engage with cultures and experiences.
ex.t: 当____17____（旅行）时，我们与文化和经历互动。

ex.s: Campers have a three-hour morning class engaging with a morning theme (9am to 12 noon) and a one-hour lunch break, followed by another three-hour class engaging with an afternoon theme (1pm to 4pm).
ex.t: 营员有三个小时的上午课程（上午9点到中午12点）参与上午主题，然后是一小时午休，接着是另一个三小时的下午课程（下午1点到4点）参与下午主题。

ex.s: The inability to engage with longer-term causes and consequences leads to some of the world’s most serious problems: climate change, biodiversity collapse, and more.
ex.t: 无法关注长期的原因和后果导致了一些世界上最严重的问题：气候变化、生物多样性丧失等等。

ex.s: Hundreds of scientists, writers and academics sounded a warning to humanity in an open letter published last December: Policymakers and the rest of us must engage openly with the risk of global collapse.
ex.t: 数百名科学家、作家和学者去年12月在发表的一封公开信中向人类发出警告：政策制定者和我们所有人都必须公开面对全球崩溃的风险。

ex.s: To be sure, more than half of teens still engage in these activities, but the ___44___ have slimmed considerably, Between 1976 and 1979, 86 percent of high school seniors had gone on a date; between 2010 and 2015 only 63 percent People say, Oh, it's because teenagers are more responsible, or more lazy, or more boring, “but they're ___45___ the larger trend,” said Jean Twenge, lead author of the study, which drew on seven large time-lag surveys of Americans.
ex.t: 诚然，超过一半的青少年仍参与这些活动，但___44___（比例）已大幅缩小：1976至1979年间，86%的高中生谈过恋爱；2010至2015年间只有63%。人们说，哦，这是因为青少年更负责任、更懒或更无聊，“但他们___45___（是）更大的趋势，”该研究的主要作者珍·特温格说，该研究基于七项大型的美国时间滞后调查。

ex.s: I find that doing so energizes my instruction, engages my students, and demonstrates to them how abstract concepts play out in the real world.
ex.t: 我发现，这样做让我的教学更有活力，让学生更投入，也向他们展示了抽象概念在现实世界中的实际运用。

ex.s: A good story engages our curiosity, emotions and imagination.
ex.t: 然而，新的研究表明狗能够解读人类行为，并对更友好或更大方地给予食物的人表现出偏好。

ex.s: For the next 18 years, Dorian engages in various evil deeds, even murdering the painter of the portrait.
ex.t: 在接下来的 18 年里，多里安做出了种种恶行，甚至谋杀了为他画肖像的画家。

ex.s: The accident was very severe and he engaged in many exercises but he did work again and raised lots of money for charity.
ex.t: 事故非常严重，他进行了大量的锻炼，但他后来确实重新工作了，并为慈善事业筹集了很多钱。
